subject: Re: QuantumHealth SOW — pricing, capacity and scope redlines
messages:
From: Elena Murphy <elena.murphy@quantumhealth.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: QuantumHealth SOW v2 redlines and capacity ask

Markus —

Thanks for the demo last week. Attached is our consolidated redline on the SOW (QuantumHealth_SOW_v2_redlines.pdf). Two high-level items we need to resolve before we can present to our legal ops:

- Capacity uplift: we need an interim +30% burst pool for Q1 (Jan–Mar) with a clear top-up price.
- Pricing carve: proposed effective monthly minimum and an early-termination credit formula.

I've highlighted a couple of clauses that reference your standard SLA and the audit logs retention — Samir (cc) is tracking SOC-2 evidence that we will need. Can someone on your side confirm a) whether the burst pool is achievable on Dedicated and b) pricing for the interim period?

Attachments: QuantumHealth_SOW_v2_redlines.pdf (annotated), QH_signature_block.docx

Best,
Elena Murphy
Director, Strategic Sourcing
QuantumHealth

Subject: Re: QuantumHealth SOW v2 redlines and capacity ask

Elena —

Appreciate the clear redlines. Quick responses to the two asks:

1) Burst pool: we can offer a temporary Dedicated burst pool for Q1 with a guaranteed reservation for the month-by-month top-up. I need to confirm GPU type and concurrency assumptions with infra (noted below).
2) Pricing: we can propose a timebound uplift rate for the burst (example: +35% premium on committed unit price) or a blended monthly minimum. I'm looping in Karthik for legal and Laura for commercial to draft a concise change order.

Proposed next steps:
- Karthik to review redlines and flag terms that need MSA-level exceptions.
- Laura to propose an interim pricing table and draft a change order template.
- Quick call Thurs 1/15 at 10am PT to agree redline approach? Let me know if that works.

I'll also attach an internal draft of the change order once we have Karthik's legal flags.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: QuantumHealth SOW v2 redlines and capacity ask

Markus / team —

I reviewed the annotated SOW quickly and pulled out the items that will need legal signoff or alternative language:

1) Term & early termination: QuantumHealth proposes a monthly minimum and an early-termination credit. We can accept a pro-rated credit, but need to limit cumulative credits (proposed cap = 3 months of committed spend).
2) Burst pool: operationally fine, but we need a statement that burst capacity is subject to availability and does not change the base SLA for committed capacity.
3) Data retention & audit logs: SOC-2 evidence can be provided, but we cannot change platform retention beyond our standard 90-day audit log export without an enterprise addendum. Recommend we offer an export schedule and an optional extended retention add-on.
4) Liability / indemnity tweaks in Exhibit C: redline here is broad — suggest narrow to direct breaches and gross negligence; counterparty wants broader language.

I can prepare markups for the MSA and a short change order for the burst/pricing uplift. For procurement, we should keep the change order tightly scoped (capacity/pricing term + start/end dates + signature block). Any commercial comments, Laura?

Karthik
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

Elena / Samir —

Thanks for the detailed notes and the redline PDF. Per Karthik's comments, attached is a short draft change order that:

- Grants a Q1 (Jan 1–Mar 31, 2026) Dedicated burst pool equal to +30% of committed units
- Applies a timebound uplift of +32% on committed price for burst consumption (detailed table in attachment)
- Adds an optional extended audit log export schedule (30/60/90 days) as a billable add-on
- Caps early-termination credits at 3 months of committed fees

We recommend a 30-minute legal + procurement sync to sign off on the change order and the MSA adjustments. Proposed slot: Fri 1/16 9:00am PT or Mon 1/19 10:00am PT. If the DocuSign link would help, we can prepare a post-call package.

Attachment: QH_change_order_draft.pdf (contains pricing table and signature block)

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Account Management
Redwood Inference
